title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Facilitator takes AI notes of in-person meetings
summary: Hold: the briefing says the Android counterpart is in development, but its current roadmap record says Rolling out. The Windows licensing, default and control paths are supported; the assertion that in-person sessions have no organiser is not documented.
